units.characteristics: the fortified offended heart; the friend closer than a brother
units.gist: a brother offended more unyielding than a strong city; a friend who sticks closer than a brother - the heart that walls itself in offence vs the bond that holds

units.characteristics: the bias of first impressions; partiality; the impartial lot
units.gist: partiality to the wicked; the first-stated case seems right until examined; the lot ends quarrels - the self's susceptibility to premature conviction
whoever is slack in work is a brother to the destroyer - sloth reframed as active harm

units.characteristics: the wife/relationship as received favour from the LORD
units.gist: he who finds a wife finds a good thing and favour from the LORD (thread w/ 19:14)

units.characteristics: the dispositions of low and high estate
units.gist: wickedness brings contempt/disgrace; the poor entreat, the rich answer roughly - the roughness of the secure vs the entreaty of the low (w/ Job 12:5)

units.characteristics: integrity over status; desire that needs knowledge
units.gist: better poor-with-integrity than crooked-fool; desire without knowledge misfires, hasty feet miss the way (w/ Ecc 6:9)

units.characteristics: interested friendship that deserts the poor
units.gist: wealth brings friends, the poor deserted even by brothers; the poor pursue with words and grasp nothing (w/ Job 19:14)

units.characteristics: the lying witness who mocks justice; iniquity devoured as food
units.gist: the false witness breathes lies and will not escape; the worthless witness mocks justice, the wicked mouth devours iniquity

units.characteristics: the son, discipline-in-hope, keeping/despising one's way
units.gist: foolish son ruin; keeping the commandment keeps life; discipline your son for there is hope; violence to parents; ceasing to hear = straying

units.characteristics: teachability as profiting from reproof; the reachable vs unreachable self
units.gist: listen to advice and gain wisdom; strike a scoffer (simple learn) vs reprove the understanding (he gains knowledge) - thread w/ 9:7-9

units.characteristics: sloth as self-starving torpor; ease unfit for folly
units.gist: slothfulness casts into deep sleep and hunger; the sluggard won't lift his hand to his mouth; luxury unfitting for a fool

units.characteristics: the good as from-the-LORD; generosity as lending to God
units.gist: the prudent wife from the LORD; generosity to the poor lends to the LORD who repays; (the king's wrath/favour one lives under, arena)

units.characteristics: the winnowing discerning gaze; chesed as the throne's support
units.gist: the king's terror; he winnows evil with his eyes; steadfast love and faithfulness preserve/uphold the throne - power endures on covenant-love not terror

units.characteristics: professed vs real faithfulness (the rarity of the truly faithful)
units.gist: many proclaim their own steadfast love, but a faithful man who can find? - the gap between advertised and actual chesed

units.characteristics: integrity that blesses forward; character legible early
units.gist: the righteous who walks in integrity - blessed his children; even a child known by his acts (pure and upright) - character self-disclosing and generative
unequal weights abomination; the buyer's disparaging lie then boast; bread by deceit sweet then gravel; hasty inheritance un-blessed (w/ Job 20:12)

units.characteristics: the God-given senses; the self opaque to its own way
units.gist: the hearing ear and seeing eye the LORD made both; a man's steps are from the LORD, how can he understand his way? (w/ Job 38:36, Ecc 3:11)

units.characteristics: strife-avoidance, prudence, guarded speech; wise speech as a jewel
units.gist: honour to keep from strife; plans by counsel; slander spills secrets; the rash 'it is holy' vow a snare; lips of knowledge a jewel above gold (w/ Ecc 5:2-6); the sluggard; (youth/age glory = arena)
